The context repeatedly mentions that on April 18, 1942, a surprise air raid on Japan (Tokyo) was conducted by 16 B-25 bombers. Multiple passages identify the leader of this raid:
- "Doolittle leads air raid on Tokyo on Apr 18, 1942"
- "Lieutenant Colonel James Doolittle hit Tokyo"
- "The Doolittle Raid... on April 18, 1942, was an air raid by the United States of America"
- "Sixteen B-25 bombers took off... led by (then Col.)..." (referring to Doolittle in other contexts)

The man who led the raid is Jimmy Doolittle (or James Doolittle).

<answer>Jimmy Doolittle</answer>
